mapper.sql: em.id, em.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, em.meal_date, em.meal_type, em.menu_id, em.food_items, em.intake_amount, em.appetite, em.special_needs, em.allergies, em.record_by, em.record_by_name, em.create_time, em.update_time, em.remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM elder_meal em LEFT JOIN elder e ON em.elder_id = e.id ORDER BY em.meal_date DESC, em.meal_type ASC
SELECT FROM elder_meal em LEFT JOIN elder e ON em.elder_id = e.id WHERE em.elder_id = #{elderId} ORDER BY em.meal_date DESC, em.meal_type ASC
SELECT FROM elder_meal em LEFT JOIN elder e ON em.elder_id = e.id WHERE em.meal_date = #{date} ORDER BY em.meal_type ASC
SELECT FROM elder_meal em LEFT JOIN elder e ON em.elder_id = e.id WHERE em.elder_id = #{elderId} AND em.meal_date = #{date} ORDER BY em.meal_type ASC
